TABLE.NAME: tool_openapi_tokens
TABLE.COMMENT: Plugin-issued tokens, for reading the documentation only

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Label, so an admin can tell which integrator this token is

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the token, never the plaintext

FIELD.NAME: allowedfunctions
FIELD.COMMENT: One function name per line; null means the full catalog

FIELD.NAME: iprestriction
FIELD.COMMENT: Same shape as core external_tokens.iprestriction; null means no IP restriction

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: Personal data, covered by the privacy provider

TABLE.NAME: tool_openapi_ip_rules
TABLE.COMMENT: IP allowlist entries, each with its own optional function scope

FIELD.NAME: iprange
FIELD.COMMENT: A single IP or CIDR range, as address_in_subnet() expects

FIELD.NAME: description
FIELD.COMMENT: What this entry is, for whoever reads it later

FIELD.NAME: allowedfunctions
FIELD.COMMENT: One function name per line; null means the full catalog
